title: The Last Ferry
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The ferry at Bitter Creek Crossing has run for forty years, carrying settlers, soldiers, and outlaws across the river. Ferryman Amos Reed has one rule: he carries everyone, no questions. When the law comes for the outlaw he carried yesterday, Amos must decide what the rule costs him — and what the river remembers.
